modules.module_title: Ensure Compliance with Data Security and Privacy Regulations

pcs.pc_description: follow applicable data privacy laws and organizational data security policies
verify compliance through audits, assessments, and regular reviews
report any breaches or non-compliance to relevant authorities in a timely manner

modules.module_title: Secure data collection, storage, and transmission

pcs.pc_description: ensure the collection, storage, and transmission of sensitive data is encrypted and securely handled
apply access controls to data storage and ensure only authorized personnel have access
verify secure transmission protocols to prevent unauthorized access during data transfer

modules.module_title: Implement access controls and authentication mechanisms

pcs.pc_description: set up role-based access control (RBAC) and enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for system access
regularly monitor and review access logs for suspicious activities and potential security threats
ensure regular updates, patches, and maintenance of systems to address vulnerabilities

modules.module_title: Identify and mitigate data security risks

pcs.pc_description: assess potential risks related to data security, including malware, insider threats, and external attacks
implement proactive measures and technologies to mitigate identified security risks
maintain a risk management log to track and address security incidents and vulnerabilities
implement data backup, disaster recovery, and availability strategies to ensure business continuity
protect data from unauthorized alteration or corruption by using encryption and validation mechanisms
regularly test data integrity and availability to verify the reliability and accuracy of stored information

modules.module_title: Ensure secure data disposal and archiving

pcs.pc_description: securely dispose of or anonymize data that is no longer needed or legally required
implement data retention policies and ensure data is archived securely for future retrieval and compliance purposes
apply secure deletion methods to remove sensitive data from storage and systems when no longer required

modules.module_title: Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to maintain security standards

pcs.pc_description: work with IT security, legal, and compliance teams to implement and maintain security measures
provide necessary documentation, training, and updates to stakeholders regarding data privacy and security
communicate security policies and procedures effectively to all relevant personnel within the organization
